sections.title: Biography
sections.lead: Born 21 December 1928 at Rajahmundry, Andhra Pradesh.
body: Satguru Sri Sivananda Murty was born on Marga Sirsha Sudha Navami of Vibhava Nama Samvatsaram, in Revati Nakshatram and Kanya Lagnam — Thursday, 21 December 1928, at 00:45 — in Rajahmundry, Andhra Pradesh.

He taught Sanathana Dharma as something to be lived rather than merely believed, holding together its theory and its daily practice, and drawing equally on the example of Lord Sri Rama and Lord Sri Krishna. From that pairing comes the teaching at the centre of his work: God as Man, and Man as God.

He wrote and spoke for the householder rather than the renunciate — for people with work, families and obligations, who wanted to know what dharma asked of them in the circumstances they actually had.
After retiring from government service he built a small house in a mango grove at Bheemunipatnam and named it Anandavan. Potti Sreeramulu Telugu University conferred a doctorate on him in 2005.
